passages.note: Assembly Floor final-passage vote on SB 3; Gipson listed among the Ayes.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 48 Noes Count 26 NVR Count 5

passages.provision_quote: the Director of Finance shall calculate an adjusted minimum wage. The calculation shall increase the minimum wage by the lesser of 3.5 percent and the rate of change in the averages of the most recent July 1 to June 30, inclusive, period over the preceding July 1 to June 30, inclusive, period for the United States Bureau of Labor Statistics nonseasonally adjusted United States Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers (U.S. CPI-W). The result shall be rounded to the nearest ten cents ($0.10). Each adjusted minimum wage increase calculated under this subdivision shall take effect on the following January 1.
passages.note: Chaptered SEC. 3 (Labor Code 1182.12(c)): after the scheduled step increases, wage adjustments are calculated by formula each year, with no further legislative vote required.

rows.reasoning: Gipson voted Aye on Assembly Floor final passage of SB 3 (2015-2016). Beyond the scheduled step increases to $15, Labor Code Section 1182.12(c) as enacted by SB 3 requires the Director of Finance to calculate an adjusted minimum wage annually based on the CPI-W, taking effect each following January 1 with no further legislative vote. This matches the rung text 'tie it to the cost of living, so it rises automatically each year without new legislation,' and excludes rung 2's requirement that adjustments occur 'only when lawmakers vote to.'
